newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SUMMARIES IN THE SPANISH FIRST DIVISION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SUMMARIES IN THE SPANISH FIRST DIVISION.

text.p: Summaries of Spanish first division matches played on Sunday:
Barcelona 3 (Ronaldo 2nd, 89th, Juan Pizzi 74th) Real Sociedad 2 (Alberto Albistegi 59th, Darko Kovacevic 90th pen). Halftime 1-0. Attendance 75,000.
Deportivo Coruna 4 (Rivaldo 13th pen, 45th, Corentine Martins 19th, Rafael Martin Vazquez 59th) Hercules 0. 3-0.
Extremadura 0 Real Oviedo 2 (Oli Alvarez 12th, Paulo Bento 34th). 0-2. 8,000.
Sporting Gijon 2 (Yuri Nikiforov 19th, Julio Salinas 29th) Zaragoza 0. 2-0. 19,000.
Celta 0 Real Betis 2 (Alexis Trujillo 47th, Tomas Olias 90th).
